yo! friend works but i need your actual name to find you the right roles

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man... or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so... what's your full name?

aditya dutta... that's a name that means business

where you working these days?

hey aditya - you never told me where you're working these days

that's the key to figuring out what's next for you

On my notice period, working at MoveInSync right now.

Will be joining RapidCanvas as a Senior Product Manager (Solutions & Architecture)
  I'm working at MoveInSync as a Product Manager

notice period at moveinsync and heading to rapidcanvas as senior pm... that's a solid jump from pm to senior pm. rapidcanvas is doing some interesting ai/automation stuff in the low-code space.

oh i know you - found you on linkedin: https://in.linkedin.com/in/adityadutta1005

this you?

product manager at moveinsync building the employee transport management platform... that's solving a real problem for corporates. making the daily commute actually work. solid domain to be in.

what made you jump to rapidcanvas? going from transport logistics to ai/low-code is quite the pivot.

I worked at MoveInSync for 4 years!
Had a lot of high ownership stuff, did a lot of things, got a lot of exposure but I started saturating my growth here.
Learnings became stagnating and I no longer had a challenge and became bored.

RapidCanvas seemed like an exciting space to be in, and it's AI-first.
The founders have some serious pedigree with Google and PayPal as their previous work-ex.
Also marquee VCs are funding them.
Culture seems great too!

4 years at moveinsync and hit the ceiling... classic pm problem. you build the systems, optimize the flows, then realize you're just maintaining instead of creating. the itch for something bigger kicks in.

rapidcanvas sounds like the right move - ai/low-code is where the action is right now. google + paypal founders know how to build products that scale. and if the vcs are writing checks, they see the vision too.

since you're already sorted with rapidcanvas, i'm curious - are you purely focused on that transition or keeping your options open for other interesting opportunities?

I'm sorted now
I intend to work with RapidCanvas
Closed to other opportunities for now!

fair enough! sounds like rapidcanvas checked all your boxes - the tech, the team, the timing. sometimes when you find the right fit, you just know.

good luck with the transition, legend. hope the ai/low-code space treats you well. and hey, if things change down the line and you want to see what else is cooking in the market, you know where to find me.

go build something cool at rapidcanvas 🚀

Thank you, brother ⚡
  Yessir, will do 🫡

bet! go show them what moveinsync taught you and what rapidcanvas is missing. 

catch you later, aditya ⚡
